source_evidence.establishes: Pinned launch order: repository task construction, then write_repo_codex_hooks and ensure_codex_hooks_trusted before run-root creation or Codex driver construction.
The exact external-checkout hook path, mkdir plus Path.write_text payload operation, four-event trust state, and project-trust check exercised by the REP-003 guard.
Initial guidance and populations are assembled before iteration one.
Phase 2 and Phase 3 complete before the next iteration samples.
Working guidance sampling and the exact _run_agent -> evaluate_workspace -> _finalize_result order wrapped by REP-003's post-agent, pre-evaluation terminal checker.
Workspace materialization and final guidance extraction.
Population score synchronization before later selection.
Run-scoped lineage/artifact persistence and population RNG ownership.
Admission does not imply probabilistic later selection.
The model adapter exposes no provider model seed and archives solver transcripts/changed paths.

checker_evidence_contract.required_event_rule: The REP-003 wrapper invokes the immutable checker once after _run_agent returns and before evaluate_workspace starts. Every rollout emits exactly one protocol terminal event; successful evidence joins the checker event to the final solver/Candidate.lean hash, while rejection is classified explicitly.
fail_closed_cases: checker, Python, command, output, or candidate mismatch
checker_evidence_contract.failure_derived_rule: Liveness requires a validated nonzero check event whose guidance snapshot precedes and differs from the produced tree; flags or failed events without the validated join cannot establish liveness. A rejected rollout cannot produce an optimizer candidate.

terminal_event_statuses.CHECK_EVIDENCE_VALIDATED: The wrapper-owned post-agent, pre-evaluation checker event and the post-evaluation immutable snapshot join both validate.
terminal_event_statuses.RUN_FAILED_CHECK_EVIDENCE_CONTRACT: Missing, malformed, drifted, or candidate-mismatched evidence rejects the rollout without optimizer production.
terminal_event_statuses.RUN_FAILED_ROLLOUT: The rollout failed outside the checker-evidence contract but still emitted one terminal event.

safe_preflight.same_as_execution: Uses the frozen /usr/bin/python3 3.9.6 invocation, immutable checker bytes, injected Lean toolchain, and tracked-clean pinned EconCSLib checkout used by execution.
safe_preflight.observes: Real Lean stdout, stderr, nonzero exit status, and one recorded/tamper-checked event.
safe_preflight.forbidden_writes: No model call, quota use, formal run root, formal ledger write, historical state inheritance, or historical state mutation. A quiescence barrier must establish three identical samples before and after preflight. Durable non-SQLite contents and SQLite logical contents must remain unchanged; SQLite page layout, WAL, SHM, journal files, directory mtimes, and checkpoint transitions are normalized away.

pre_reservation_external_hook_guard.phase: Before protocol verification, clean Lean checks, dependency/Hydra checks, authentication, safe preflight, _new_run_root, reserve_attempt, or model access in the same execute invocation.
pre_reservation_external_hook_guard.same_as_pinned_launch: Runs the pinned checkout's scaling_evolve.providers.agent.codex_hooks.write_repo_codex_hooks and ensure_codex_hooks_trusted through the locked offline uv environment against the exact external checkout path.
pre_reservation_external_hook_guard.real_write_semantics: Calls write_repo_codex_hooks twice. Each call reaches write_codex_hooks_file, mkdir(parents=True, exist_ok=True), and Path.write_text on <external-checkout>/.codex/hooks.json. Byte-identical results establish idempotence.
pre_reservation_external_hook_guard.audit_evidence: Records checkout and hooks paths, pinned runner and hook-writer source hashes, before/after payload hashes, trust result, missing-event list, and unchanged logical projections of fresh REP-003 and all DEV-002/DEV-003/REP-001/REP-002 historical runtime state.
pre_reservation_external_hook_guard.fail_closed: Any write, payload, path, source-identity, project-trust, hook-event-trust, quiescence, or state-projection failure raises before a formal root or attempt reservation. Model calls and quota remain zero.

phase_and_iteration_order: The working optimizer is sampled before each rollout.
A produced optimizer enters the population only after the source rollout and Phase 2 sampling.
Only a strictly greater iteration can select an admitted candidate later.

rng_semantics.claim_boundary: EvE sampler seeding is not provider/model determinism and cannot establish a causal condition effect.

snapshot_semantics.ordinary_files: Hash relative path, permission bits, and file contents; ignore mtimes.
snapshot_semantics.sqlite: Hash committed schema and table rows through a read-only query-only connection; ignore WAL, SHM, journal files, page layout, and checkpoint transitions.
snapshot_semantics.quiescence: Require three consecutive identical logical snapshots before and after exact-runtime preflight, then require equality across the preflight boundary.
snapshot_semantics.fail_closed: Durable ordinary-file changes, committed SQLite logical changes, unreadable databases, or failure to settle before the bounded timeout reject preflight.

repairs.observed_failure: REP-002 ordinal 1 reserved its one-shot attempt before pinned EvE tried to write the external checkout's .codex/hooks.json; sandbox denial therefore consumed a zero-model cell.
repairs.repair_boundary: No model, prompt, task, checker, terminal contract, Lean source, turn budget, evaluator, seed, condition semantic, or retry policy changes. Only protocol-owned identity/paths/RNG domain plus the real pre-reservation external-hook write/trust guard and its auditor checks differ.
